title: Designing Interventions to Realize a Target Response Partition on a Causal DAG
banked_reason: D-0.5 bounded revision remained below the field floor: the reviewer assessed the forest algorithm and sparse hardness as incremental/letter, and theorem-level containment against Charon 2006, Xu-Xiao 2007, and Rao 1993 remained unresolved.
gap_reasons: The load-bearing unrestricted-reachability directed-code and alarm-placement comparisons remain unavailable at theorem level; consequently the forest and sparse-boundary advances are not yet supported as field-tier novel (tier=letter below novelty_target=field).

The terms “owned” piece/targets/representatives and their decomposition, ownership rule, and merge schedule are not formally specified, so DP is not yet a uniquely defined algorithm whose 64-state guarantee can be assessed.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery attempted to turn the presolved test-cover reduction into a field-tier graph frontier by specifying a constant-state forest DP, an equality-preserving sparse hardness reduction, and nonlaminar representation witnesses. One bounded revision could not make the DP invariant uniquely checkable or complete the theorem-level Charon/Xu–Xiao/Rao containment audit, and the independent reviewer assessed the resulting package as letter/incremental rather than field. The constructions remain plausible and reusable, but reopening requires the full source audit plus a concrete same-estimand field-strengthening theorem rather than another presentation-level revision.
tldr: Which affordable separate interventions realize exactly a requested response partition on a known causal DAG? The proposal seeks a 64-state exact algorithm for forest transitive reductions and a matching sparse hardness boundary, with explicit witnesses that retain collider-driven crossing supports. This would turn interventional coarsening from a descriptive resolution into a constrained experiment-planning problem.
gap: Existing interventional coarsening defines a partition from given interventions; tree alarm placement optimizes a different all-node unit-cost diagnosis objective. The weighted partial-target, partial-readout, exact-equality planning frontier remains unverified as a published result.
fill: Prove the one-vertex interface recurrence and exact algorithm, prove equality-preserving depth-two sparse hardness with an optimum identity, and give graph-level RePaRe handoff and representation witnesses.
